item.title: Lake Haruna: A Crater Lake with Winter Ice Fishing — Guide
item.description: Lake Haruna sits within the caldera of Mount Haruna, its calm waters framed by the mountain’s distinctive jagged peaks, including the sharply pointed Sugenoyama, creating one of Gunma’s most photogenic natural landscapes. Warmer months bring pedal boats, lakeside walking paths and hiking trails up the surrounding peaks, while in the coldest winters, when the lake freezes solid, it transforms into a popular ice-fishing destination where visitors drill through the ice to catch smelt, a distinctive seasonal activity.
